name: Carmen Crespo Díaz - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the fisheries exploiting demersal stocks in the Western Mediterranean Sea
part_text:
1. This report is Parliament's opinion, not a law. It asks the European Commission to rewrite the rules for fishing in the western Mediterranean by December 2026. It wants fishing days decided by looking at all fish stocks together, not just the weakest one, and it wants social and economic effects counted. It also asks for more flexibility on fishing days, better science, and action against illegal fishing by non-EU boats.

2. 
- Fishing days would be set using all stocks, not just the most vulnerable one.
- It affects trawler crews in Spain, France and Italy, especially small family boats.
- The Commission is asked to propose a revised regulation by 1 December 2026.
